title: Canonical intrinsic realization of rational smooth purity
statement: Fix the datum $P$ of [def-pur-conventions] and the intrinsic rational/common-stage constructible categories of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a smooth separated morphism of pure dimension $d\geq0$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and fix a compactification $c$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements] and the coefficient-normalized constructible adjunction system $S$ [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Define the canonical realization $\gamma^{\mathrm{sf}}_{f,K}:Lf^*K(d)[2d]\xrightarrow{\sim}G(K)$ of the transported purity of [thm-pur-rational-and-qbar-purity] in these intrinsic categories as follows. On the finite-Tor integral domain [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], transport the coefficient-unit orientation reconstructed in [thm-pur-adic-reconstruction], normalized by its finite diagonal traces. Use the coefficient line and quotient/root-normalized comparisons of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], [cor-pur-adic-and-rational-smooth-dualizing-complexes]. The finite integration is exactly the counit transpose of [def-pur-smooth-purity-map], [def-pur-smooth-trace] at the coefficient unit. For a general integral input form the projection/trace composite and transpose under the specified adjunction; its inverse is transported finite smooth purity. Localize this map with the coefficient mate of $S$. Its source comparison uses inverse localization commShiftIso at $2d$ on the shifted coefficient line followed by the integral tensor/pullback object formulas [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]; it does not identify the rational and integral shift objects. For $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, use the literal finite field of each object, transport through the canonical small coefficient-model equivalence, and apply the common-stage exceptional comparison. Scalar source comparisons are the tensor, line, pullback and coherent shift comparisons, with the general scalar shift pinned at one and the existing common-stage transition shift retained. All coefficient associators and identity-transition unitors are retained. The canonical source and scalar/ordinary transports are those of [def-pur-canonical-purity-source-transports].

proof.text: Construct finite integration and the uniquely finite-trace-normalized integral orientation as in the statement. For finiteDualizingPlus apply the existing etale bounded-below exceptional-image theorem to the bounded-below coefficient unit, using compactness of Y. For pullFiniteTor, integralSource_mem, and representativeTor use the equality of integral constructibility and integral finite Tor amplitude, and preservation by integral pullback and completed tensor. Uniqueness of the normalized orientation gives orientation_eq_adic and then the trace-transpose equality. Rationalize integralIso and compose with the specified exceptional mate. For ordinaryTensor_eq, first project the tensor clause of ordinaryModel_existsUnique at general coefficient parameters through the cached ordinaryMonoidal presentation, then specialize this API at the purity setting. The coefficient unit and left unitor use this same monoidal structure with the integral derived category explicit, retaining all unit and tensor normalizations. Small coefficient-model scalar associativity and Shrink.algEquiv inverse equations give the literal finite-stage transport and common-stage composite. Unfolding the published category-instance definitions proves their equality; transport the stage isomorphism along this equality before applying the common-stage inclusion. The five remaining named theorem obligations retain the complete proof plans in their Lean docstrings. The orientation, ordinary source, projection, integral isomorphism, and model-back scalar functor retain their original bodies with explicit return types in the canonical categories.

For rationalIntegralSource_eq, use the object clauses of rationalDerivedTensor_existsUnique and rationalDerivedPullback_existsUnique. Both rational operations preserve the displayed integral representatives. Reduce equality first to the integral full subcategory and then to its ambient objects. Apply the generic ambient-object formula for the inherited full-subcategory shift, proved by unfolding it in an abstract category; at the nonnegative exponent d the signed Tate line is the positive tensor power defining twist. The remaining tensor inputs agree definitionally. This preserves the specified localization shift comparison used by rationalSourceComparison.

Use the extracted finite trace setup and its proved smoothPullAugmentation_isIso theorem. Its public declarations keep their original names and are re-exported by this module; the split is only to meet the per-file compile limit. The finite trace normalization obligation remains here.

For smoothPullToOrdinary_existsUnique, use good flat K-flat complexes and their quasi-isomorphism localization L. The ordinary pullback factorization supplies the first comparison, integralDerivedPullbackComparison supplies the second, and whiskering the strict pullbackAugmentation with DerivedCategory.Q supplies a natural transformation between the representative functors. Apply normalized_descent_comparison from the source-transport module: finiteTor_of_iso transports the given finite-Tor membership to every representative, and the inverse of smoothPullToOrdinaryOnGood is precisely the comparison-conjugated augmentation, by the inverse-composition formulas. Full faithfulness of localization whiskering descends that transformation; essential surjectivity transports its invertible component to K. Naturality proves the displayed formula for every good representative and every presenting isomorphism. Unpack the good full-subcategory objects to obtain the stated quantifiers and uniqueness. No new hole or existence choice of unconstrained data is introduced.
